summary: Full E2E test of Kalamà (FastAPI+Mongo+React). Backend: 13 pytest tests, all pass (public menu 26 dishes, contact/franchising forms, admin login incl. wrong password 401, JWT protection, menu CRUD with public-menu persistence checks, 409/404/422 edge cases). Frontend: all 6 languages (IT/EN/ES/DE/FR/PT) render without crash/blank page with translated nav/hero/filters; 26 real dishes rendered; all 7 category filters filter correctly; menu-note pill shows 'Carta reale Kalamà Málaga · Prezzi in euro'; ES location cards show correct EN fallback for kind/hours (no undefined); contact + franchising forms show success toasts; admin flow (wrong pwd error → login → 26 rows → edit gozo 16.50 visible on public site → restored to 15.00 → create test-polpo visible publicly → delete → logout → password required after reload) all pass. ONE real bug found: WhatsApp Sliema link is https://wa.me/undefined. Menu left in original state: 26 dishes, Gozo €15.00, no test items.

minor.issue: Lockout counter never resets after the 15-min window expires: failed count keeps growing and locked_until is refreshed on every wrong attempt, so once count>=5 the IP is effectively re-locked by any single later wrong attempt. Consider resetting count when the window expires.
hmac.compare_digest(str, str) raises TypeError (500) if a submitted password contains non-ASCII characters. Compare encoded bytes instead.

CORSMiddleware uses allow_credentials=True with CORS_ORIGINS defaulting to '*' — browsers reject wildcard+credentials. Only impacts requests if a wildcard is configured (currently CORS_ORIGINS is set in .env).

ui_bugs.issue: Sliema WhatsApp button href is 'https://wa.me/undefined' — the sliema entry in /app/frontend/src/locations.js has no 'whatsapp' field (should be '35679900819'). Málaga href is correct (https://wa.me/34610755695).

action_items: Add whatsapp: "35679900819" to the sliema object in /app/frontend/src/locations.js so [data-testid=whatsapp-sliema] points to https://wa.me/35679900819
Optional hardening: reset brute-force counter after lockout window, encode passwords before hmac.compare_digest
critical_code_review_comments: locations.js sliema lacks the 'whatsapp' key consumed by WhatsAppFloat.jsx -> produces wa.me/undefined; add a defensive guard (skip rendering the button when l.whatsapp is missing).
Admin token is stored in localStorage (no httpOnly cookie); acceptable for a single-password mini panel but worth noting security-wise.
Menu seed only runs when collection is empty; changing MENU_SEED later will not update an existing DB (documented behaviour, no action needed now).
seed_data_creation: Temporary: test-polpo menu item (created and deleted), TEST_QA contact/franchising messages in db.messages (harmless test records). Menu restored to the original 26 dishes with Gozo Sandwich at €15.00.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression suite: /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (run with `cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/backend_test.py -v`). It performs exactly ONE wrong-password login then a correct login (which clears the lockout counter) — do not add extra wrong-password attempts. All admin CRUD tests clean up after themselves. Only outstanding defect: wa.me/undefined for Sliema.
rca_of_the_issue: WhatsAppFloat.jsx builds hrefs as `https://wa.me/${l.whatsapp}` by mapping over locations; the sliema record in locations.js was never given a 'whatsapp' property (only phone/phoneHref), so template interpolation yields the string 'undefined'.
